newsitem.title: USA: Gold stock analyst picks new favorites - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Gold stock analyst picks new favorites - Barron's.

text.p: John Doody, the publisher of the Gold Stock Analyst newsletter, told Barron's business weekly that gold stocks were still a good investment despite recurring volatility in the price of the metal.

Doody said gold stocks do not rise and fall on the price of gold alone. Investors should look at how the market is capitalizing a company's production and at the current market cap per ounce of proven and provable reserves, he said.
The latest additions to his top-10 gold stocks are Alta Gold Co, Miramar Mining Corp and Indomin Resources Ltd.
